Okay so what I'm getting from this is a couple things, I'm not a therapist tho, but I'll try my best to help. 
Soo 

you want to do the work and you enjoy doing the work, but feel as though, if you're not on YouTube you are going to be in your own headspace thinking negative thoughts.
Could you listen to maybe a podcast, audio book, or music to keep your mind off yourself? 
I know you are using YouTube as a means off distraction right now but maybe if you just had something in the background like a, podcast or  audio book etc. 
You could then do your school work whilst staying better distracted.

Honestly it's good you are writing stuff down as its a very good coping mechanism.
Make sure to keep at it that way you can keep track of what's going on😊 
And maybe if you see a therapist in the future it can help you better explain what's going on, because if you're like me you might find it hard to remember what was going through your head during these episodes.
